data.name: Arlan
data.gender_notes: Arlan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old High German 'aralan' meaning 'ruler, eagle warrior'. Arlan carries the strong and regal connotations of both eagles and rulers. The name Arlan carries the meaning “Eagle ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arlan usually hope their child will grow to embody eagle ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing strength, courage, and leadership in one's spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Arlan belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Eagle ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arlan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

Historically, the name has been carried by important figures in medieval storytelling and is thus deeply ingrained within European folklore.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Arlan represents the warrior spirit within all of us: the courageous fighter who conquers personal and spiritual challenges, the fearless defender of our beliefs, and the triumphant ruler over our thoughts and emotions.
